final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp AS p ON p.account_id = a.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.account_id, s.region, s.record_count, s.record_count - v.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS v WHERE v.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT region, AVG(difference) AS region_avg FROM step3 GROUP BY region) SELECT s.account_id, s.region, s.record_count, s.difference, s.difference - r.region_avg FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS r ON s.region = r.region WHERE s.difference > r.region_avg ORDER BY s.difference - r.region_avg DESC LIMIT 10
